counting_rule: Review-document counts include Markdown reports, guides, instructions and provenance; repeated local checkout copies are counted explicitly then deduplicated. JSON/text/log/image files are separately counted supporting artifacts, never additional browser/test passes.
source_revision_limit: Early reports without an explicit tested SHA retain null; introduced/modified documentation SHAs are recorded separately, never invented as runtime test revisions.
